Published online:
September 7, 2026

Geographic focus:
Europe (broadly), Switzerland, Germany, Euro Zone; secondary focus on US and US-Iran geopolitical context

Temporal focus:
T1. Historical report [YES] — reports on weekend election results, Novartis trial outcome, recent US-Iran strikes
T2. Forward-looking reporting short-term risks (next few weeks/months) [YES] — ECB rate decision Thursday, US CPI, Fed rate hike expectations
T3. Forward-looking reporting long-term risks (next quarters/years) [NO]

Synopsis:
European equities edged lower Monday, dragged by Novartis (-3.3% on failed drug trial) and a risk-off tone from rising oil prices triggered by US-Iran vessel strikes in the Strait of Hormuz. Energy stocks outperformed (+1.2%). Political risk in Germany emerged as the far-right AfD won Saxony-Anhalt state elections with 44%, a blow to Chancellor Merz. Macro focus shifts to the ECB rate decision (25bps hike widely expected Thursday) and US CPI data, with Fed rate hike expectations already elevated following a strong jobs report. US markets are closed for a public holiday, limiting volume.
